character.lede: A one-storey cornflower-blue cottage has a steep terracotta side gable, a wide front cross gable and a west brick chimney stack. A railed dining deck at the back looks over an oval pool.

spots.line: A mission armchair, a loveseat and a bookshelf make the nook.
A breakfast bar with two stools stands beside the range.
A pedestal table, six chairs and a chandelier fill the dining room.

facts.style: One-storey cornflower-blue cottage: steep terracotta side gable, wide front cross gable, gabled dormers front and back, timber-clad gabled entry vestibule with a white arch, west brick chimney stack from grade, cottage foundation beds, rear L with a railed dining deck over an oval pool

character.truths: The Core sits on a shelf in the Living Room, in sight of the door. There is no television. The kitchen has a breakfast bar. A single storey with a dining deck over an oval pool and monkey bars.

details.rule: every beat of an adult or teen persona (13 or older) gets a detail (before, after, steps, fact); pair beats first

paperless: [note] AI features are off by default. If you turn them on they can use a local model.
[note] Office document conversion is not wired up in this build; OCR and archiving of PDFs and scans works.
immich: [note] Bundles its own database and a machine-learning service, so first start takes a while.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
radicale: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
no QA screenshot (the app has a bare web page)
sync away from home is not claimed
kiwix: marketplace: Ships with an empty library: the compose runs kiwix-serve on /data/library.xml with no content and no way in the Hub to add or register ZIM files; the QA capture shows "No result".
libretranslate: [note] Works offline once language models are downloaded.
Listing says "works fully offline": banned wording (sec-offline)
Likely already heavy in the existing stories
tandoor: [note] Overlaps Mealie; pick one per story.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
ntfy: [cloud-link] iOS push goes through an upstream relay setting; Android and web can stay local.
No sign-in is configured: anyone who can reach the URL can publish and subscribe. Keep it on the home network.
iOS push goes through an upstream relay setting; Android and web can stay local.
QA screenshot is an empty app with a notifications-blocked banner (shows the product).
vikunja: QA shot is a sign-in wall
vaultwarden: [note] Bitwarden-compatible server, unofficial. Do not say "Bitwarden".
monetr: marketplace: Replaces lists Mint, which Intuit retired in 2024.
marketplace: Licence is the Functional Source License (not open source).
hortusfox: Do not say it keeps plants alive
Plant health alerts and a public gallery exist: keep the gallery off in a story
calibre-web: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
marketplace: Documented default admin credentials (admin / admin123); no QA capture.
joplin: [note] Joplin Server only; the Joplin apps are separate.
[note] No API is mentioned in the listing; treat as web interface only for agent purposes.
marketplace: Joplin Server carries its own Personal Use License: not open source and limited for business use.
stirling-pdf: QA screenshot is a sign-in wall that prints default credentials
already in the persona pool: share cap risk
miniflux: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Integrations push to outside services if switched on (Pocket, Telegram, webhooks)
blockbench: Projects live in the browser (IndexedDB) or in files the person saves: the Core serves the app, it does not hold the models
The listing names Minecraft models; say "game models" or "block models" in copy
Free-text store claim "never sees your models" is accurate for the container
habitica: The sign-up page in the capture carries a cookie-consent banner: check the self-hosted build for analytics scripts before saying it sends nothing out
Game, not a health or behaviour tool: no outcomes
privatebin: Footer of the screen says the server has "zero knowledge": do not repeat
Overlaps Cryptgeon and Enclosed: one per household
drawio: Stateless: diagrams live in the browser or as .drawio files on the person's own device. The Core serves the editor only, so never say the diagram sits on the Core.
Listing says nothing else phones home: leave it.
QA screenshot is a blank editor.
linkwarden: Sharing links publicly needs inbound reach: keep the story to saving, not sharing
The Pocket name in replaces is stale
changedetection: The UI shows a "Let us host your instance!" banner linking to the vendor's hosted service
Does not hide the Core from the sites it watches
